hooks.name: Migration checklist
hooks.description: Reminds the agent of the RLS and Flyway rules whenever a new migration file is created.

action.prompt: A new Flyway migration was just created. Before finishing, check it against .kiro/steering/database-and-exorcism.md: (1) RLS is enabled on every new table and policies use (select auth.uid()); (2) every new corpse_id foreign key and user_id column has an index; (3) CHECK constraints stay consistent with the allowed values in the steering file, and an existing constraint is changed with a NEW migration, never by editing V1 or V2; (4) no secrets or database passwords appear in the file; (5) tell the user to run `pnpm db:migrate` and `pnpm test:db`, and update .env.example only if a new variable was introduced. Do not edit migrations that already existed.
